description: Walk-forward temporal validation and calibration evaluation - implement chronological model evaluation with strict temporal safety and calibration performance analysis
steps: Enhance backend/app/prediction/walk_forward.py to integrate with PredictionService for database-backed feature extraction with temporal cutoffs
Add leakage detection tests to ensure no future data usage in model training or calibration fitting
Create backend/scripts/run_walk_forward_evaluation.py using WalkForwardEvaluator with expanding window validation
Enhance backend/app/prediction/calibration_engine.py to connect with database historical predictions for walk-forward-safe fitting
Create backend/scripts/evaluate_calibration.py to compare uncalibrated vs calibrated performance on out-of-sample data
acceptance_criteria: Walk-forward evaluator correctly implements temporal boundary enforcement (training data before T, validation after T)
Feature extraction uses database queries with WHERE match_date < T to prevent future data leakage
Leakage detection tests validate no test information flows into training for any component
Calibration engine fits on chronological training data and evaluates on genuinely unseen validation data
Calibration evaluation shows OOS improvement metrics or reports INSUFFICIENT_HISTORICAL_SAMPLE when appropriate
verification: python backend/scripts/run_walk_forward_evaluation.py completes with temporal safety validation and no leakage warnings
python backend/scripts/evaluate_calibration.py produces calibration comparison report with OOS validation results
pytest backend/tests/prediction/test_walk_forward.py shows all temporal safety tests pass
